statements.answer_quote: For black exhaust smoke, the diagnostic system indicated is the fuel system
statements.statement: For black exhaust smoke, the indicated diagnostic system is the fuel system.

statements.answer_quote: black smoke may indicate excessive fuel entering the cylinders
statements.statement: For black exhaust smoke, excessive fuel entering the cylinders may be indicated.

statements.answer_quote: correct CDR-valve function is determined by checking vacuum with a water manometer
statements.statement: During air-intake PMCS checks, correct CDR-valve function is determined by checking vacuum with a water manometer.

statements.answer_quote: The authorized cleaning method is wiping the CDR valve and hoses with a rag
statements.statement: During air-intake PMCS checks, the authorized cleaning method is wiping the CDR valve and hoses with a rag.
During air-intake PMCS checks, solvent cleaning of the CDR valve is prohibited.

statements.answer_quote: it will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve
statements.statement: During air-intake PMCS checks, solvent cleaning will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve.
